name: wizard
description: Generate scripts a human runs for work an agent must not launch. Two skills. generate (/wizard:generate) is the interactive bash wizard for dashboard clicks, credentials, and other steps an agent cannot perform. unattended (/wizard:unattended) emits a bash or PowerShell script for a fully scriptable procedure whose only human role is privilege or policy: the human launches it once, and it writes JSON the agent reads back. generate scopes the stages from the repo (reading key NAMES only from a live .env, never values), authors them onto a fixed hardened library (TTY-only fail-closed prompts, https-only URL opening, hidden secret entry, single-quoted 0600 .env upserts with a gitignore check, repo-confirmed gh secret/variable writes over stdin, names-only summary), prints the full STAGES block for explicit human approval BEFORE the script is made executable, and never runs the wizard itself. The human does, in their own terminal. Ephemeral by default: built for one run, committed only when the setup path should live in the repo. The generated script requires bash (Windows: Git Bash or WSL); gh is optional: CI-secret stages degrade to a visible warning plus a closing-summary entry when it is absent.
